returns.heading: Returns
returns.failed: The returns could not be loaded.
returns.hasGuide: The guide of the way back is made.

create.title: New return of order {number}
create.description: Choose the units that come back and why. Nothing moves until someone approves it.
create.available: ({count, plural, one {# unit left} other {# units left}})

description.refund: The goods can come back. The money is given back by hand when they arrive.
description.exchange: The goods can come back. Choose the products that go out instead: the replacement order is made now, already confirmed.

reject.title: Reject the return
reject.description: The goods do not come back. The customer is not told the note.

cancel.title: Cancel the return
cancel.description: The units go back to being returnable.

in_transit.title: Mark the return on its way
in_transit.description: The goods are on their way back. The people who receive them are told.
in_transit.done: The return is on its way back.

receive.title: Receive the return
receive.description: Say in which condition each line came back. The stock moves with it.
receive.warehouseDefault: The warehouse that sent most of it

complete.title: Complete the return
complete.description: Close the return. A refund records the money given back by hand: the platform does not move any money.
complete.amountInvalid: That amount is not valid. Write an amount like 12.50.

return_guide.button: Make the guide of the way back

shipping.heading: Shipping
shipping.failed: The guides could not be loaded.
shipping.empty: This order has no guide yet.

failure.unknown_outcome: The carrier did not answer: a guide may exist. Check it before making another.
failure.invalid_answer: The carrier answered with something the platform cannot use.
failure.auth: The carrier rejected the credentials of the connection.
failure.credentials_unreadable: The credentials of the connection cannot be read. Save them again.
failure.label_invalid: The label the carrier gave cannot be kept.
failure.record_failed: The carrier made the guide and the platform could not write it down.
failure.marked_failed: Someone marked the guide as failed.
failure.not_queued: The cancellation could not be sent. Ask again.

blocked.not_confirmed: A guide can be made once the order is confirmed.
blocked.price_approval: A guide can be made once the price is approved.
blocked.no_address: A guide needs the shipping address of the order.
blocked.no_phone: A guide needs a phone number of the recipient.

cancel.title: Cancel the guide
cancel.description: The carrier is asked to cancel guide {guide}. It stays "cancelling" until the carrier answers.
cancel.descriptionManual: The carrier of guide {guide} cannot be asked to cancel it. The guide waits as "Cancelling" and then as "Cancel failed"; once you have told the carrier yourself, mark it as voided.

mark_voided.title: Mark the guide as voided
mark_voided.description: Guide {guide} is dead on our side. The carrier is not asked: tell it yourself if it still has the guide.
mark_voided.done: The guide is marked as voided.

pickup.title: Request a pickup
pickup.description: The carrier is asked to come for the guide {guide}.
pickup.cutoffPassed: The cutoff of the day passed: the pickup would be for the next day. Request it anyway?

guide.title: Make the guide of order {number}
guide.description: The carrier makes the guide and its label. A guide can be cancelled while the package has not been picked up.
guide.payerFreeShipping: The order has free shipping: the store pays.
guide.codReasonCollects: The order is cash on delivery and not paid yet. The amount is the order's and cannot be changed here.
guide.codReasonPrepaid: The order is already paid or paid in advance.
guide.pickupHint: This carrier makes the guide together with a pickup. Leave it empty to use the next valid day of the connection.
guide.pickupInvalid: Write a day and a window that ends after it starts, or leave all three empty.
guide.notesHint: The courier reads it on the label. The packing note never goes on it.
guide.noConnection: No connection of the store can make a guide. Connect a carrier in Settings.

locations.hint: This carrier asks for its own list of places. Choose the department and the municipality of the delivery address.
locations.failed: The carrier could not list its places. Try again in a moment.

guide.returnTitle: Make the guide of the way back
guide.returnDescription: A guide from the customer to the warehouse, for a carrier that can make it. It is never cash on delivery.
guide.warehouseDefault: The warehouse that sent most of them
guide.returnPayer: Who pays: {payer} (the choice of the return).
guide.returnDone: The guide of the way back was requested.

messages.heading: Messages
messages.failed: The messages could not be loaded.
messages.empty: No message has been asked for about this order.
messages.unknownRoute: Sent a way this page does not know

route.channel_template: By the conversation, with an approved template

delivery.failed: The channel did not deliver it

reason.missing_variable: The message needs data the order does not have.
reason.too_long: The message is longer than the channel takes.
reason.no_template: The store has no template for this message.
reason.no_channel: The customer has no conversation or email to reach.
reason.window_closed: The channel window is closed and there is no approved template or email.
reason.template_unavailable: The approved template is not available.
reason.customer_erased: The customer asked to be forgotten.
reason.consent_revoked: The customer withdrew consent to order messages.
reason.unknown: The server gave a reason this page does not know.

notify.label: Notify the customer
notify.hint: Starts from the setting of the message template.
